Review on changed standards, mechanisms, evidence or coverage. The
[registry](control-registry.json) owns these mappings; [engineering](engineering.md)

Automatic controls run in the common lane. Runtime controls act in the live system;
their tests cover only the stated cases. Manual controls require the named review
or probe. Implementation and evidence links do not assert a current execution or pass.

## Mechanisms and coverage

### C-PORTABLE — Portable regression lane (automatic)

Controller, HTTP adapter, setup and spectator regressions. Includes gameplay record validation and bounded evidence retention using synthetic observations. Passive planner/skill/supervisor composition, continuation and uncertainty are covered by real-component synthetic fixtures. Local-refusal regressions exercise expired roots before execution, after entry, before/after preparation and at publication; preserve passive terminal verification, original charges and explicit Observe. Paired Pause, pending/recovery, receiver/capture, retained-anchor and global-reserve faults must still stop. These synthetic checks do not qualify native gameplay. Explicit --fast checkpoint command compiles Python, runs Ruff correctness diagnostics, Import Linter contracts, JS syntax, markdown-it-py link/image targets, document stewardship, governance and diff whitespace. Relevant focused behavioral tests remain a lead-selected obligation. The default full command additionally renders diagrams, runs all Python tests and delayed-image viewer regressions. Structured player tests cover fixed HTTP transport, stable requests, archive images and SDK framing, not real host behavior. Apply S-CODE whole-loop variation and independently shaped portability-fixture requirements where relevant; tests must demonstrate coverage. Synthetic cases do not qualify native or cross-game behavior. Optional derived routing caches require bounded wide-exploration and whole-runtime continuation regressions: forgetting cached candidates must preserve retained evidence, current guards and ordinary observation/input. Ordinary capture-refusal regressions cover key/text/click nonpublication, combined fatal faults, delivered-prefix charging/no replay, first-refused prompt rotation, unprepared geometry refusal and explicit Observe with original root exhaustion; extracted production native gates retain stale-filename rejection. These are component fixtures, not graphical qualification. MCP presentation regressions preserve canonical/cache data, unknown outcomes and full evidence; test missing-source and different-current-view retention and exact progress references. Advisory read-wait tests retain other bounds and exercise condition wakeup, closure, concurrent reads and uncertain durable claims. These component/SDK fixtures do not qualify actual host cadence. Lifecycle diagnostic regressions retain same/changed-session images after an actually published unexpected input, preserve original dispatch/reservation/unknowns and suppress executable phase/reconciliation/adoption/map/memory/game-time credit. Zero-input Observe remains usable after input allowance exhaustion within existing wall/frame/request/custody bounds; unchanged bootstrap-cleanup cases cover known same-session Resume. Typed-record regressions preserve strict constructor/raw-input/receipt validation and fresh serialized containers without per-export revalidation; malformed dispositions cannot receive progress credit. Owned lifecycle ordinary regressions cover changing unfamiliar receivers, raw final creation/Save/load delivery, text-prefix attribution, Save cancellation, settled explored-menu cleanup and historical reopen. Paired preflight menu-to-normal, stale creation commitment, mismatched retained preflight, root exhaustion, click resize and user Pause cases preserve custody/effect boundaries. Stale lifecycle-child/commit regressions preserve a positively healthy phase and unchanged limits without dispatch; current-evidence corruption, controller lease loss and paused-identity takeover still take stopping paths. Roots without an existing phase retain their prior rejection policy. These source checks do not qualify native gameplay or apparent responsiveness. Known authenticated native-rejection regressions preserve healthy scope and original charges, omit nondelivery from creation effects, audit menu cleanup and restore rejected creation stages. These synthetic checks do not qualify the rebuilt native. Initial-load regressions exercise explicit load-mode admission, current identity, zero inherited game time, own Save/new-child reload and reopened ledger/timeline; fresh admission and wrong-character negatives remain. Expired setup regressions retain rejected child deadlines while allowing bounded explicit Observe and zero-input MAIN_MENU abort/normal exit, with paired controller failure. These are synthetic, not native qualification.

Owner: maintainer. Trigger: Fast structural checks on each configured local commit; focused tests on affected behavior; full portable checks at coherent integration/formal acceptance and PR/main CI events.
Enforcement: Opt-in project-local pre-commit hook runs --fast. Actions controller job runs full default checks for all PRs and pushes to main; no required-job path filters. GitHub concurrency cancels superseded PR runs only. Main retains strict Actions-app15368 controller requirement under ruleset25346774. Hooks remain bypassable; a fast pass never establishes behavioral/full portable acceptance. Hosted activation evidence is recorded in the issue/PR after the configuration is exercised.
Failure response: Preserve failure output, fix the cause and rerun before claiming portable acceptance.

Current initial-Load/expiry slice reuses ordinary game entry and existing controller/ledger/timeline facilities. Cost: The complete corrected Python suite takes 737.743 seconds locally, plus diagram/viewer checks. Use fast and focused checks for routine development, then the existing full local/hosted lane for coherent qualification. Record failed runs and avoid duplicate full local checks for documentation-only changes. Native and model/tool/display costs remain separate.
Follow-up: #176 retains organic interaction and its general observation boundary; #145 retains all original fresh seven-day outcomes. Exercise the corrected runtime in a new frozen finite campaign, keep native race/pixel/geometry gaps explicit, and require exact publication-head CI before formal acceptance/merge. Reconcile later campaign failures through these existing controls; no new review service or per-action gate.

### C-RUNTIME — Live authority and input guards (runtime)

Single-controller mission dispatch and admission, original typed operation accounting, HTTP trust boundary, historical memory observer and spectator input freshness. One current typed mission contract and one authenticated writer use exact controller leases, immutable sources, original root/child/mission limits and durable intent/result accounting. Captured samples retain their as-of identity and original clocks across healthy newer views under unchanged custody; semantic applicability is separately proved. Ordinary healthy non-equivalence refuses input and requires a distinct decision/Observe lineage; future clocks, revision contradictions and immutable-source changes remain faults. Native independently checks receiver, session, revision, boundary, custody, Pause/takeover, pending control and original clocks/deadline. Retained native-issued captures preserve their original timestamp and complete normalized observation metadata; non-image-conditioned input may survive incidental rendering churn without retargeting or renewing freshness. Clicks and image-conditioned input retain applicable exact-image/geometry checks. Registered normal Save start and provisional identity readmission use native-state equivalence; setup, confirmation, actual identity-screen and recovery retain their stronger policies. Owned creation/save/load, committed transition/effect proof, first-normal identity, separate charged readmission and canonical identity adoption remain mandatory. Unknown delivery is never replayed or rewritten: bounded diagnostic collection and explicit effect reconciliation retain original receipts, costs and uncertainty. Ordinary known-unpublished capture refusal preserves only qualified read-only custody until explicit Observe and new intent; fatal ownership, processing/storage, global budget and historical-integrity faults still stop. Original navigation/activity/menu/editor/item scopes, quantities and deadlines survive continuation, with no automatic prompt confirmation or new allowance. Quiescent handoff/claim retains actor history and unfinished Work; history, memory, advice and packets grant no input authority. Normal Finish requires exact owned exits and coherent objective Work, writes an immutable report and sends no native input. The spectator distinguishes live custody and unresolved effects from historical frames, memory, results and process samples. The protocol owns detailed predicates and supported limits; portable tests and dated native reports provide separate evidence.

Owner: controller and viewer maintainer. Trigger: every relevant request, observation and image decode.
Enforcement: Implemented at runtime; regression execution is C-PORTABLE. Source references alone establish no behavioral pass.
Failure response: Reject or freeze further dispatch; expose error and reconcile by observation before explicit resume.

### C-USABILITY — Operator understanding review (manual)

Overview, navigation, control ownership, freshness, recovery limits and next decision. Whole player-configuration responsiveness and visible useful progress. Walk overview and immediate links for purpose, capabilities/limits, rationale, decisions and evidence; inspect changed visuals at ordinary window width, text equivalents and consequential failure/recovery paths against current contracts. Inspect UI flows when changed. Under S-UX, assess the whole host/model/context/tool/execution/display configuration against prospectively declared numerical cadence, longest-stall, quality and exception criteria. Count useful progress, failures and deadline misses; reject a slow configuration unless actual useful overlap satisfies the same criteria. Do not treat animation, filler inputs, fast ACKs or cached-token ratios as passing evidence.

Owner: lead with operator feedback. Trigger: user-facing behavior/guidance change and milestone review.
Enforcement: Required review under S-UX/S-DOCS/S-WORK; no automatic usability gate.

### C-BOUNDARY — Architectural dependency contracts (automatic)

Declared controller and server dependency boundaries, including indirect imports through harness modules. All passive gameplay modules, including supervision, must not import controller, HTTP, CLI or process/build tooling. Shared movement policy cannot depend on consumers, clock, filesystem or transport. Import Linter uses the pyproject.toml forbidden contracts: controller cannot depend on server, CLI, declared network modules or build tooling; server cannot depend on CLI/tools; CLI may compose both. Fourth forbidden contract isolates harness.movement; negative import fixtures exercise it.

Owner: harness maintainer. Trigger: common command; architecture changes require rule review.
Enforcement: Common command runs the real lint-imports executable and propagates failure; temporary source fixtures exercise allowed composition and direct/indirect forbidden imports.
Failure response: Remove reversed dependency or review the boundary and checker together before accepting changed architecture.

### C-REVIEW — Design and independent change review (manual)

Consequential designs, implementation, tests, delegation and exceptions. Lead owns design/integration and verifies returned evidence; at most two workers use separate project-local worktrees and named disjoint paths, with shared runtime serialized; fresh-context review assesses contracts, risk and maintainability before acceptance. Apply S-CODE's outcome/reuse/platform-contract review across code/docs/workflow/controls: compare available capabilities and total cost against the overall objective, identify the residual project gap and configured platform guarantees, and reject unjustified duplication or disproportionate defense/recovery. Simplification and deletion are valid outcomes; deliberate accelerators/enablers are also valuable when expected repeated use, learning or future cost reduction warrants upfront effort. Review the relevant horizon, uncertainty, upkeep and reassessment trigger, without demanding immediate payoff or precise ROI. Routine choices add no evaluation report or approval layer. Before publication, inspect explicit Git author/committer identities and all new commit messages, including co-author trailers, under S-WORK. Use repository-local Git identity configuration. Before merging a PR whose Issue completion awaits merged-main validation, read gh pr view --json closingIssuesReferences, require an empty list and re-read after removing references. Prose negation is not a parser control; use GitHub computed data, no custom keyword parser. For source-dependent consequential claims, inspect executable predicates, caller cadence, units and defaults against actual outcomes; preserve mistaken rationale and which actions preceded correction. For changed native boundaries, compare synthetic category/action/row/transition assumptions with the pinned producer and retained visible frames; reject fictional UI labels used to arm control state. Reuse the existing regression/native lanes; do not infer native support from passing mocks. Development-first delivery places cohesive independent implementation/test/evidence review at integration/acceptance; consequential new boundaries retain earlier design/risk review. No routine readiness reviewer or per-action critic is added to ordinary development play. A complete unchanged unassisted development run can support its prospective functional outcome after exact-source checks/review; it is never retroactively relabeled held-out evidence. Review selection follows the decision-and-risk guidance in docs/project-management.md: choose applicable product/player/observer/architecture/research perspectives rather than every lens for every change. For consequential input/memory/learning/autonomy changes, verify the prior-document and research crosswalk required by S-ARCH, including conflicts and transfer limits. Independent proxy review does not establish real-user usability or semantic truth; no new automated semantic checker is added. For agent/memory changes, check S-ARCH's active/background ownership, automatic-versus-model feedback, attribution and revisable-advice boundaries; gameplay independence review checks that routine reasoning/curation does not depend on the engineering lead. This adds no per-action approval. At meaningful discussion/research/review/delivery checkpoints, check S-WORK action-item dispositions in the existing Issues/Project and applicable updates to authoritative principles, standards, controls and guidance; proposals and filed findings are not completed behavior. Apply S-ARCH/S-CODE generality and CDDA-class portability requirements: challenge task/menu-specific assumptions that obstruct ordinary input, inspect whole-loop recovery and changing-interface evidence, and separate shared responsibilities from game bindings. Record remaining coupling and actual portability limits. This is integration review, not a per-action gameplay gate. Check the documentation/GitHub authority split: retain purpose-specific capability/evidence summaries and design decisions, remove copied live fields, stale current claims and repeated attempt narratives, and keep detailed evidence in dated reports. This is manual integration review, not a duplicate-status tracker or semantic parser. For player/context changes, review the actual host-facing result separately from canonical machine records: require sufficient current decision state, exact evidence recall, preserved obligations/unknown effects, image parts and no nested envelope/history duplication. Check software versus model responsibilities and fresh-context continuation. Responsiveness claims require prospectively frozen configuration/cohort/quality/latency criteria; no new per-action approval is introduced. Distinguish persisted event/export payloads, canonical tool results and actual model-forwarded output before attributing context cost or proposing a framing fix; source/byte counts alone cannot substitute for the relevant evidence layer. Compare the maintained player working guide with selected tool schemas and phase receipts when they change; routine play must not require engineering/source archaeology or recursive runtime searches. Apply progressive exact-reference detail revelation and identify each model task's needed interpretation/choice and decision timing; deterministic verification, accounting and known-failure classification belong to software. Semantic relevance and escalation benefit remain manual design/qualification judgments, not per-action approvals. Compare needed argument fields in the actual host declaration, not only tool names; when nested shapes are unknown, freeze focused current SDK-schema help and qualify it at the actual player's natural first use. This is interface review, not a per-action approval gate.

Owner: lead; reviewer supplies independent findings. Trigger: significant change, new boundary/guarantee/dependency or integration checkpoint.
Enforcement: Required by S-AGENT and the GitHub work/PR workflow; independent agent review is manually recorded, not an independent GitHub human approval. Hosted enforcement is recorded separately in acceptance.
Failure response: Resolve material findings or record scoped owner/reason/revisit exception; after two unsuccessful worker repairs lead takes back the work.

### C-VISUAL — Rendered visual documentation (automatic)

Mermaid sources and generated SVGs in docs/diagrams. Pinned local Mermaid CLI renders every source in a headless project-local browser. Hash receipt covers sources, config, wrapper, package lock and tracked SVGs; title/description and root SVG ID are required. Explicit --write regenerates; normal checks leave tracked files unchanged.

Owner: documentation maintainer. Trigger: common command; source, renderer configuration or dependency changes require rendered review.
Enforcement: Common command fails on renderer errors, missing title/description/ID or changed input/output receipts; negative fixtures include a real parse failure. No global installation or automatic fetch.
Failure response: Fix syntax or missing setup; regenerate stale output and inspect the rendered result. Never call a denied browser launch a passed check. Resolve semantic/readability findings through C-USABILITY/C-REVIEW.

Evidence / implementation: [tools/diagrams.py](../tools/diagrams.py), [tests/test_diagrams.py](../tests/test_diagrams.py), [docs/diagrams/rendered.json](../docs/diagrams/rendered.json), [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md), [docs/overview.md](../docs/overview.md), [package.json](../package.json), [package-lock.json](../package-lock.json), [.puppeteerrc.cjs](../.puppeteerrc.cjs), [docs/decisions/004-documentation-controls.md](../docs/decisions/004-documentation-controls.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-workflow.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-workflow.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-recovery-evaluation.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-recovery-evaluation.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-passive-supervisor.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-passive-supervisor.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-integrated-player.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-integrated-player.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-walk-reassessment.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-walk-reassessment.md).

Coverage gap: Receipt freshness is not cross-host byte equality or proof against deliberate falsification. Rendering and SVG metadata do not prove meaning, accessibility for every reader or readable layout. Human rendered inspection is required. Ubuntu 24.04 CI was exercised with a scoped runner Chrome sandbox profile; other Linux hosts remain unverified.

Lifecycle: active. Rationale: Required to keep user-facing visual explanations reviewable and synchronized.. Replacement: none.

## Interpreting results

Run `.venv/bin/python tools/check.py` for the portable lane; update this map with
`.venv/bin/python tools/governance.py --write`. The latter validates before writing and
does not run gameplay. Dated executions belong in [acceptance](acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp.md)
and [work](work.md), with exact candidate, failures and unexecuted lanes.
